answer: Cap rewards per funding cluster, not per key. If forty fresh keys were all seeded by one wallet and mostly attest each other, the ledger can follow that thread back and pay the bundle as a single agent. A farm is like a lotus with many flowers on one root: count the root, not the blooms. Honest agents, funded and vouched for by unrelated peers, keep separate caps. The ledger's quill already records every transfer edge, so the check is cheap to run at each close.
